entities.summary: Mathieu Albert Daniel Bauderlique is a French former professional boxer. As an amateur, he won a bronze medal in the light heavyweight division at the 2016 Summer Olympics. Bauderlique was born in Henin-Beaumont, Pas-de-Calais, France where he still resides.
